authority.scope: complete terminal product meaning, source binding and static-view obligations; not implementation or rendered acceptance

accepted.label: Accepted closeout
accepted.text: Distinct roles: work authors; candidate integrates; proposal reviews; dev accepts; main releases. Candidate proof and expected accepted state bind a separate CAS. Developer MR/PR or authorized maintainer closeout selects the same object. Retire proposal after dev acceptance and review closure, not main release.

authority.label: Authority bounds action
authority.text: Subject, current policy, intent, facts and plan are conjunctive. Only PASS admits action. BLOCK or UNKNOWN does not execute; capability, evidence and coordination grant no permission.

brownfield.label: Brownfield adoption
brownfield.text: Brownfield: inventory inherited state, preserve domain layout and customization, expose conflicts and bind gradually. Adoption is previewable and idempotent, reversible before first governed effect; upgrade without retroactive approval of history.

candidate.label: Candidate integration
candidate.text: Combine compatible contributions, prove the selected object, then recheck and CAS the candidate ref. Record the effect; changed bases invalidate stale attempts and require fresh combination checks.

capabilities.label: Replaceable capabilities
capabilities.text: People and interchangeable Agents compose Skills, generators, verifiers and native tools. Prefer official and mature capabilities over custom machinery. Names express responsibility; versions distinguish real interpretation boundaries. Contracts bind I/O, identity, permission, cancellation and failure. Pure semantics stay separate from bounded effects; capabilities grant no authority.

compile.label: Compile, do not reinterpret
compile.text: Accepted intent compiles to transient Commitment; fresh Facts and applicable prior Attestations produce a bounded TransitionPlan and proof obligations. Source acceptance, delivery and Change completion are distinct; one active Change retains outstanding tasks until archive. Valid no-spec changes and archive retain proof identity.

coordination.label: Shared runtime, not shared truth
coordination.text: One Git-common activation, no per-worktree authority. Preview adoption; use the locked toolchain for immutable runtime activation, state migration, hook rebinding and activation rollback. After activation, reclaim unused generations from fresh operational dependencies; deferred reclamation preserves successful activation and exact partial outcomes.

effect.label: Every effect has a boundary
effect.text: Bind exact pre-state, evaluate, PASS, recheck, apply once, post-observe, attest. One linearization point per admitted resource; no global or cross-provider CAS. UNKNOWN is observed, never blindly replayed.

evidence.label: Results survive actors
evidence.text: Attestation is the sole durable semantic result, scoped by predicate, bindings, validity and verifier, never permission. Commitment, Facts and Plan are transient. Change relations and experiments are derived: no persistent workflow graph, compatibility residue, feedback ledger or memory-backed truth.

exit.label: Handoff, preserve, exit
exit.text: A new Agent continues from exact results with fresh authority. Stop writers, account for unique work, preserve useful findings, retire exact owned resources and remove discharged runtime projections.

faithfulness.label: Faithful static view
faithfulness.text: Required assertions and typed relations must be readable here or in meaningful visible aggregates. Hidden witnesses and hover cannot substitute. Geometry and legibility require actual rendered evidence.

feedback.label: Learn and evolve
feedback.text: Use outcomes and retained experiments to challenge goals, intent, implementation or assumptions. Return to research and accepted intent; observations cannot silently change standards or authority.

greenfield.label: Greenfield formation
greenfield.text: Greenfield: inspect the founding state and expected absence, then preview a minimal native scaffold through Skills. Preserve customization and upgrade provenance from first generation; first acceptance uses the same local protocol.

intent.label: Understand and accept
intent.text: Challenge interpretations with source examples. Settle scope, exceptions, assumptions and guarantees; discovery is not complete understanding. Recovered obligations are accepted, superseded, pending verification or rejected. Only accepted meaning enters official OpenSpec; compilation does not certify understanding.

lanes.label: Parallel owned work
lanes.text: Worktrees prepare and prove independently from exact bases. Fresh prewrite binds actor, lane and current facts; a four-field Lease coordinates, never stores intent or permission.

maturity.label: Target architecture
maturity.text: Target architecture, not a claim of current implementation.

model.label: Resolve model gaps
model.text: Contradiction or missing meaning blocks the affected effect. Preserve the counterexample, promote the smallest model boundary and recompile; no exception route around authority.

norms.label: Agentic-native repositories
norms.text: Agentic-native source, tests, specs, docs, rules and Skills follow one semantic owner per obligation and executable quality. Each module, config, document and temporary resource needs a current consumer and bounded lifecycle. Profiles retain native domain, layout, provider and observation freedom; governed mutation uses verified OpenSpec.

outcomes.label: Measure actual benefit
outcomes.text: Delivery is not benefit. Observe deployed identity, environment, baseline and time window. Counterexamples can invalidate current applicability without rewriting historical evidence.

peers.label: Autonomous interoperability
peers.text: Each repository retains local authority and judgment. Exchange scoped claims, artifacts and conformance, never permission. Small capability contracts grow an interchangeable ecosystem.

projection.label: One meaning, many interfaces
projection.text: CLI/JSON, SDK, CI/Forge and optional MCP/A2A project the same verdict and gaps. Code graphs and dashboards are rebuildable observations, not intent or authority.

publication.label: Deliver selected objects
publication.text: Review offers trusted objects without completed-product proof. Accepted/release targets retain proof and closeout. Zero, one or many independent remotes receive the same local OIDs; fresh peer checks preserve partial and unknown outcomes, never global atomicity.

purpose.label: Complete product
purpose.text: From problem and research to accepted intent, repository evolution, real benefit and learning. A complete composed path; a small trust kernel.

recovery.label: Recover before repeating
recovery.text: BLOCK prevents a future effect; UNKNOWN may describe an already attempted effect. Preserve reachable Git and necessary Attestations through actor or host loss. Re-observe uncertain outcomes, recompile and reauthorize before continuation; never replay blindly.

selection.label: Cooperate · compete · explore
selection.text: Cooperation: multiple compatible contributions or synthesis. Competition: zero or one. Exploration: knowledge, including negative results. All-drop is valid; preserve value before retirement.

self.label: Self-governance
self.text: ETHOS obeys the same local authority, proof and effect rules as adopters; its source, durable results and rebuildable projections remain distinct.

verification.label: Falsifiable, scoped evidence
verification.text: Prove exact candidates and combinations with falsifiable checks. Independent verification is optional unless risk or policy requires its separate trust domain. Local, independent and hosted claims stay distinct; a composite needs a responsible verifier and explicit rule. Evidence does not authorize effects.

copy.language: English with one bounded Chinese brand mark
copy.maturity_notice: Target architecture, not a claim of current implementation.
copy.subtitle: Understand intent. Compose capabilities. Evolve repositories. Verify real outcomes.
copy.thesis: A reliable, composed path for people and interchangeable Agent capabilities from understanding problems to evolving repositories and evaluating their use.
copy.title: RELIABLE REPOSITORY EVOLUTION

            "Page-specific glyph/paint/interaction evidence and complete source-to-page disposition; the overview preserves essential authority and causal distinctions."
          ],
          "reject_when": [
            "Unvisited, unreachable or unnamed pages are counted as coverage.",
            "Page-local success is generalized to the entire atlas, or interaction hides a distinction required for understanding an overview relation."
          ],
          "states": [
            "document",
            "navigation"
          ]
        },
        "scoped_view": {
          "scope": "An explicitly bounded guided story, presentation, shared view, excerpt or export; the currently visible state is its reading surface.",
          "states": [
            "guided_story",
            "present",
            "share",
            "export",
            "excerpt"
          ],
          "source_ids": [
            "product_contract"
          ],
          "evidence": [
            "The visible declared scope and all necessary identity, authority, conditions and outcome distinctions of every expressed relationship.",
            "State-specific source-to-artifact review and painted evidence; a route to a complete document does not substitute for conditions needed to interpret the current view."
          ],
          "reject_when": [
            "The view implies whole-product completeness while declaring or showing only a subset.",
            "Hidden JSON, hidden document prose, hover or leaving presentation mode is required to recover an essential guard, identity or authority boundary.",
            "Optional omitted detail is treated as a failure despite no loss of meaning within the explicitly bounded view."
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    "predecessor": {
      "scope": "Comparison with a specific prior artifact under compatible source scope and applicable acceptance policy; never product or effect authority.",
      "source_ids": [
        "product_contract"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Exact prior artifact/source/quality identities, observed evidence, review decision and statement-by-statement applicability to the candidate.",
        "Trusted prestate policy plus explicit source review for changed quality meaning; comparable metric definitions, medium, viewport and evidence plane."
      ],
      "reject_when": [
        "A prior PASS without verified identity, scope or evidence is used as the floor.",
        "A candidate loosens its own rule or copies a report to qualify itself.",
        "No qualified predecessor is misreported as automatic improvement, regression, or a reason to waive absolute acceptance."
      ],
      "qualified": "preserve_applicable_floor",
      "absent": "absolute_acceptance_without_comparison",
      "unqualified": "historical_evidence_only",
      "unknown": "unknown_no_comparative_claim",
      "candidate_policy": "trusted_prestate_and_explicit_review"
    },
    "evidence_binding": {
      "required": [
        "source_commit_and_tree",
        "quality_contract_digest",
        "artifact_digest",
        "declared_medium_and_scope",
        "verifier_identity_and_boundary",
        "observation_inputs_and_method",
        "raw_evidence_references",
        "validity_and_applicability",
        "verdict_and_missing_obligations"
      ],
      "missing": "UNKNOWN",
      "contradiction": "BLOCK",
      "declaration_validation": "not_evidence_satisfaction"
    }
  }
}

contract_invariant_source.claim_boundary: Structural source accounting; not independent semantic or rendered acceptance.

view_profile.status: semantic view obligations; geometry belongs to renderers

rules: Required copy and semantic assertions must be painted and statically readable at the reference viewport.
A meaningful aggregate can witness multiple source assertions; its content must express each selected obligation, not merely list hidden IDs.
Relations require visible causal connections or explicit readable relational text; a hidden SVG edge or hover alone is not coverage.
Metadata may trace exact source identities but cannot earn visual or semantic coverage.
Actual glyph bounds, composed CTMs, stroke and arrowhead envelopes determine geometry, not source font declarations.
The visible target notice qualifies the entire graph. Source support is not deployed behavior.
Layout, ports and routing are renderer-owned; no kernel entity is introduced to satisfy a drawing.

adopter_peer_effect.resource_scope: one adopter-local governed ref and declared effect scope

brownfield_effect.resource_scope: one adopter-local governed ref and declared effect scope

candidate_integration_effect.resource_scope: candidate Git ref and one selected proved Work Lane

ethos_effect.resource_scope: accepted-root Git ref and declared closeout scope

greenfield_effect.resource_scope: one adopter-local founding ref and declared scaffold scope

publication_effect.resource_scope: one peer-local atomic set of explicitly selected full remote refs

action_admission_gate.required_claim_selector: all applicable scoped prior Attestations selected by the current plan and policy

candidate_integration_gate.required_claim_selector: the one selected Lane claim whose exact transient Commitment, candidate base, current Lease, HEAD and proof apply

effect_admission_gate.required_claim_selector: all declared proof-plane claims whose exact subject, predicate, scope, bindings, validity and verifier apply

publication_admission_gate.required_claim_selector: Exact trusted source object, introduced range, declared target role and peer-local refs; review needs no accepted-product proof, while accepted/release requires applicable proof and closeout. Re-derive obligations before each effect.

invariants.statement: Every edge has a valid typed endpoint and unique identity.
Attestation is the only durable semantic result; Commitment, Facts, and TransitionPlan are transient exact-input values.
Every current claim carries current evidence references bound to the basis HEAD.
PASS, BLOCK and UNKNOWN are explicit at action admission; only PASS reaches execution.
Shared effect occurs only after evidence return, effect evaluation, PASS and fresh effect-time recheck.
BLOCK, UNKNOWN, contradiction, model gap, recovery and outcome-unknown have no effect bypass.
Capability, execution, proof, coordination, projection, carrier and conformance nodes cannot authorize effects.
Every effect aperture has a complete local pre-state, recheck, conditional effect, post-observation and Attestation chain.
Each independently admitted resource effect has one local linearization point; candidate and accepted refs are distinct, and no cross-repository global CAS is implied.
Independent verifier has no effect path; its only product is an exact scoped claim.
Proof planes neither imply nor replace one another; composite claims require an explicit responsible verifier and rule.
Recovery and outcome-unknown re-enter through fresh observation and recompilation before any effect.
An Attestation never grants current authority; every later operation re-observes facts and recompiles its own plan.
Actor, session, host, tool, or platform loss does not break reachable Git history or durable Attestation evidence.
Each Work Lane is coordinated only by its four-field Lease; Git and official OpenSpec facts are observed afresh.
Worktree, Lease and git-common runtime coordinate candidate preparation and own no truth or authority.

Profiles retain native domain, layout, provider and observation freedom. Complete mutation adoption uses a verified OpenSpec carrier without shaping kernel semantics; each adopter keeps local authority and judgment.
Cross-repository exchange is limited to scoped claims, artifacts and conformance; authority is never exchanged.
Projections are outward-only and may not reverse-own their source or hide required gaps.
OpenSpec and Git realize the selected terminal design but are carriers, not ETHOS semantic roots.
The effect gate, PASS verdict, fresh recheck, and admitted runner each dominate the primary effect aperture in the control/effect subgraph.
Each local aperture has a closed effect-capable ingress set containing only its contract-bound admitted runner edge.
Action and effect gates are conjunctive over their declared inputs and exact scoped-claim selector; removing a required input blocks admission.
Every autonomous repository and publication target has one complete boundary-local effect contract and one unique linearization point; no contract crosses a boundary.
Brownfield, Greenfield, self-governance, autonomous peer, and publication remote retain distinct origin, authority, judgment, and effect semantics.
Reachable Git history and durable Attestations outlive actor, session, host, tool, and platform loss without transferring authority.
Concurrent Work Lanes preserve their own Lease, fresh Git and OpenSpec facts, transient plan, and exact proof without a predicted-scope ledger.

Concurrent Work Lanes prepare and prove independently, but candidate-ref integration and accepted-root closeout are distinct exact-CAS linearization boundaries; after candidate advancement, any stale remaining Lane refreshes and re-proves before a later attempt.
Work Lanes prepare in parallel. Each CAS accepts one exact object that may synthesize multiple contributions; zero selection is valid and valuable results survive retirement.
Open interpretation is challengeable; deterministic compilation consumes accepted meaning, never certifies understanding.
Cooperation may integrate multiple contributions, competition zero or one, exploration knowledge only; all-drop preserves useful results.
The product covers research, intent, formation/adoption, capabilities, verification, delivery, use, learning, handoff and exit; the trust kernel is only its non-delegable core.
Delivered identity and passing checks do not prove actual benefit; outcome observations bind environment, baseline and window.
Required meaning is readable in the static main view or a meaningful aggregate; hidden SVG metadata and hover cannot satisfy coverage.
Target capability scope is not a claim of current implementation or deployed behavior.
Authoring, candidate integration, proposal review, accepted dev and release main are distinct roles. Proposal retirement follows dev acceptance and review closure, not main promotion.
Runtime activation, state migration, hook rebinding and rollback form one immutable transaction through the locked repository toolchain.
Every durable obligation has one narrow semantic owner. Documentation, evidence, configuration, temporary resources and physical modules require current consumers and a provable lifecycle.
Recovered obligations are accepted, superseded, pending verification or rejected; only accepted meaning enters a current owner.
Evaluate official and mature capabilities before custom machinery; declarative pure semantics remain separate from bounded effects.
Compatibility residue, feedback ledgers and memory-backed product truth do not survive terminal convergence.
Change relations and experiments remain derived capabilities over native intent and exact evidence, not new state stores.
Local Git owns publication objects; each independent remote receives the selected OIDs or reports absent, unavailable, pending or divergent separately.

meta.maturity_notice: Target architecture, not a claim of current implementation.
meta.method: capability may compound; authority, evidence, and accepted reality remain distinct
meta.product_definition: A reliable, composed path for people and interchangeable Agent capabilities from understanding problems to evolving repositories and evaluating their use.
meta.product_position: Complete repository evolution product around a small trust kernel and replaceable domain capabilities; source-supported, terminal and optional distinctions are retained per node.
meta.thesis: Preserve meaning, bound action, verify results, learn from actual use and make work continuable across people, Agents and platforms.
meta.title: ETHOS complete product architecture

attributes.semantics: Distinct roles: work authors; candidate integrates; proposal reviews; dev accepts; main releases. Candidate proof and expected accepted state bind a separate CAS. Developer MR/PR or authorized maintainer closeout selects the same object. Retire proposal after dev acceptance and review closure, not main release.
Determines whether bounded candidate execution may proceed; does not by itself admit shared-reality effect.
Human or agent identity admitted to execute; does not own repository truth merely by acting.
Current ETHOS command-plane implementation admitted to apply the already-authorized exact effect; it owns neither authority nor proof and cannot bypass the fresh recheck.
A boundary-bound single-use executor admitted only by the autonomous peer fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor proof.
Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; no remote claim decides local truth.
Durable verifier-bound statement of the autonomous peer effect outcome; it carries evidence but mints no authority.
Boundary-local re-observation of authority, exact state, scope and bindings immediately before the adopter peer effect.
Fresh local observation of the autonomous adopter peer repository before effect admission.
Boundary-local observation of the autonomous peer ref after the attempted effect.
An independently governed adopter with its own authority, facts, conformance judgment, accepted Git reality and local effect aperture.

Transfer owned work with exact recoverable results and fresh authority, retire only after value is accounted for, and remove owned installation/runtime projections when exiting without losing repository history.
Persistent verifier-bound statement of what was observed, decided, proved or effected; mints no authority.
External authority binding for principal, subject, scope and validity.
Selects bounded intent under applicable external authority; authority is not inferred from execution or evidence.
A boundary-bound single-use executor admitted only by the brownfield fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor proof.
Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; neither grammar nor remote claims decide local truth.
Durable verifier-bound statement of the brownfield effect outcome; it carries evidence but mints no authority.
Boundary-local re-observation of authority, repository identity, expected inherited state, scope and bindings immediately before the brownfield effect.
Fresh inventory of existing history and repository-owned facts, preserving unrelated state and exposing conflicts before adoption effects.
Boundary-local observation of the exact brownfield ref after the attempted effect.

Brownfield: inventory inherited state, preserve domain layout and customization, expose conflicts and bind gradually. Adoption is previewable and idempotent, reversible before first governed effect; upgrade without retroactive approval of history.
Single-use command-plane execution admitted to advance only the candidate ref from the freshly observed expected HEAD.
A remaining Work Lane whose expected candidate base no longer equals the advanced candidate HEAD; it must refresh its base and re-prove before another integration attempt.
One exact proven candidate object may contain one contribution or multiple compatible contributions and their synthesis; combination proof is required before candidate-ref CAS.
Linearizes one proved Work Lane into the local candidate train; concurrent preparation remains parallel, while ref advancement is one-at-a-time.
Durable evidence of the candidate-ref effect and its post-state; it carries proof without transferring authority.
Re-observes candidate ref, selected lane HEAD, ancestry, current Lease, transient Commitment, and proof immediately before integration.
Selects at most one proved, nonconflicting Work Lane for the next candidate-ref attempt; it owns no queue, priority, or reusable permission.
The newly observed candidate-ref HEAD after one successful lane integration; it becomes the exact base for later integrations and the proof target for accepted closeout.
Re-observes the candidate ref after the CAS attempt and binds the observed result to the attempted lane integration.
The exact candidate-ref HEAD from which admitted Work Lanes diverge and against which a lane integration is freshly compared.

Interchangeable Skills, generators, verifiers and observers declare input, output, identity, version, permission, cancellation and failure. Conformance enables an ecosystem without a second lifecycle.

Cooperation admits multiple compatible contributions or a verified synthesis; competition admits zero or one; exploration can retain negative or inconclusive knowledge. All-drop means no integration, not destruction. Revalidate the combination whenever the CAS baseline changes.
Transient normalized acceptance with exactly schema version, Change identity, and acceptance, compiled from one exact official OpenSpec Change snapshot.
Deterministic compilation from explicit Commitment, Facts, applicable Attestations and policy.
New claim with explicit rule, responsible verifier, provenance and bounded scope.
Applies an explicit inference rule to named input claim identities; never amplifies authority or scope.
Content-addressed evidence and receipts remain inspectable after transient execution disappears.
Evaluates required returned evidence, exact authority, scope and current bindings before shared effect.
Re-observes authority, repository identity, expected state, scope and exact bindings immediately before effect.
Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; neither grammar nor remote claims decide local truth.
Self-governance and model evolution cross the same kernel and effect aperture; no legislator bypass.
Current candidate ref, HEAD and tree from which admitted Work Lanes diverge.
Interruption of execution without erasing durable roots or version reality.

Actual-use observations and retained experimental knowledge challenge goals, intent, implementation or assumptions and propose fresh intent; they do not grant authority or silently rewrite acceptance.
Context-bound observations over exact repository and dependency bindings; never durable authority.

One Git-common activation, no per-worktree authority. Preview adoption; use the locked toolchain for immutable runtime activation, state migration, hook rebinding and activation rollback. After activation, reclaim unused generations from fresh operational dependencies; deferred reclamation preserves successful activation and exact partial outcomes.
Shared Lease, transaction, receipt and runtime projection below one Git common directory; it coordinates a repository family but owns no semantic truth.
Current versioned state and exact-CAS substrate; not ETHOS itself.
A boundary-bound single-use executor admitted only by the greenfield fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor proof.
Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; neither grammar nor remote claims decide local truth.
Durable verifier-bound statement of the greenfield effect outcome; it carries evidence but mints no authority.
Boundary-local re-observation of founding authority, expected absence, scaffold scope and exact bindings immediately before creation.
Founding authority, domain seed, expected absence, and minimal owner-native scaffold from which Accepted zero may be created.
Boundary-local observation of the founding ref and scaffold after the attempted effect.

Greenfield: inspect the founding state and expected absence, then preview a minimal native scaffold through Skills. Preserve customization and upgrade provenance from first generation; first acceptance uses the same local protocol.
One-shot exact-bound receipt; mints no authority and does not authorize mutation in another repository.
Separate trust identity that re-executes or checks declared proof; no repository effect path.

Challenge interpretations with source examples. Settle scope, exceptions, assumptions and guarantees; discovery is not complete understanding. Recovered obligations are accepted, superseded, pending verification or rejected. Only accepted meaning enters official OpenSpec; compilation does not certify understanding.
Executed proof bound to one lane result HEAD, transient Commitment, and exact repository facts; it cannot authorize another lane or repository.

Before controlled retirement, reconcile all unique work and useful positive, negative or inconclusive results into current owners or exact recoverable evidence. Declining integration never authorizes destruction; discharged retention obligations end.
The expiring lane-to-holder relation: lane identity, holder identity, generation, and expiry only.
Isolated preparation domain; mutation here is not yet accepted shared reality.
Bounded claim from local executed proof; implies no other proof plane.
Preserve conflict, promote the smallest model, recompile, verify and absorb or retire residue; no shim or parallel truth.

Official OpenSpec is the sole tracked accepted intent, specifications, design, tasks and archive. Source acceptance can precede delivery; the same active Change retains outstanding obligations and archives after they are settled. Valid no-spec Changes compile positive acceptance; archive preserves proof identity. Reopen as fresh intent, not rewritten history.
CAS intent or receipt exists but fresh post-observation cannot bind the attempted effect to the current state; replay is forbidden until re-observe.
Repository-owned semantic sources and verification assets retain their native owners; ETHOS binds rather than clones them.

People and interchangeable Agents compose Skills, generators, verifiers and native tools. Evaluate official and mature capabilities before custom machinery. Stable names express responsibility; independently interpreted compatibility, migration or evidence boundaries justify versions. Contracts bind I/O, identity, permission, cancellation and failure. Pure semantics stay separate from bounded effects; capabilities grant no authority.
Re-observes the exact reality boundary after the attempted effect.

Fresh repository-root, branch-role, actor, four-field Lease, Git-state, changed-path, and official OpenSpec gate before tracked mutation. Artifact origin, existence, placement and effect are distinct; native producer ownership, exact staged bytes and surviving consumers govern projection and deletion admission. Executable topology policy shares its package runtime identity.
Historical evidence remains predicate-, binding-, validity- and verifier-specific. Current selection grants no inherited authority; any later effect needs fresh admission.
Observe the problem, expected value and current environment; source availability is not accepted understanding.
Portable schema for expressing equivalent relations, bindings and verdicts; it grants no authority and owns no truth.
A target-bound single-use executor admitted only by the publication fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor remote truth.
Durable verifier-bound statement of exact applied, failed, pending or unknown peer outcomes; it neither grants authority nor turns review into accepted product proof.

Fresh source trust, applicable proof, target policy and exact peer-local refs immediately before each independent effect or already-matching claim; earlier preflight or peer success does not authorize reuse.
Boundary-local provider observation of every selected remote ref after the attempted publication effect.
An explicitly selected remote Git ref target with provider-local exact CAS; it is not an ETHOS adopter, repository truth owner, or cross-provider atomic participant.
Fresh provider observation of the selected target ref, request binding, and signature trust; not adopter conformance.
Derived views may be regenerated from authoritative roots and must not become a parallel truth store.

BLOCK prevents a future effect; UNKNOWN may describe an already attempted effect. Preserve reachable Git and necessary Attestations through actor or host loss. Re-observe uncertain outcomes, recompile and reauthorize before continuation; never replay blindly.
Unique linearization point for the ETHOS self-governance repository shown in magnified section; the same local transaction law applies to every adopter boundary.
One hook-install operation reports the common hooks path, immutable runtime identity, every linked worktree checked or repaired, and exact retained or removed generations.

Agentic-native source, tests, specs, docs, rules and Skills follow one semantic owner per obligation and executable quality. Each module, config, document and temporary resource needs a current consumer and bounded lifecycle. Profiles retain native domain, layout, provider and observation freedom; governed mutation uses verified OpenSpec.
Replaceable research capabilities gather bounded evidence and challenge assumptions before an interpretation is accepted.

After successful activation, the sole retirement owner re-observes current operational dependencies and exact owned directory identity under a bounded selector fence before each removal. Historical observations are not executable leases. Unknown observations defer deletion; partial results conserve removed, retained and pending resources. The selector fence is not global process isolation.
Replaceable, losable execution environment.

Replaceable domain capabilities make the full research-to-outcome path usable. One portfolio owner validates original activation, packages, routing, composition and retirement before projection. Skills never own acceptance, authority, progress or lifecycle state.
Transient exact-input-bound IR; never a workflow or progress store.

Observe benefit against deployed identity, environment, baseline and observation window. Delivery, passing checks, sufficient proof and achieved goals are distinct claims; an environment counterexample can invalidate applicability without changing history.
One linked worktree coordinated by one four-field Lease; current Git and official OpenSpec facts are observed afresh for every operation.
The local Git object is offered for review or accepted publication according to target obligations; Attestation is not a prerequisite for review.
Problems, value and reality define the research question.
Research supplies challengeable evidence, not accepted intent.
Authorized acceptance records the interpreted meaning in the official intent carrier.
New repositories use shared norms with native domain scaffolds.
Existing repositories adopt norms gradually without layout cloning.
Capabilities conform to explicit identity, permissions, inputs and failure behavior.
Independent verification preserves its trust domain and claim scope.
Parallel owned work can cooperate, compete or explore.
Zero, one or multiple contributions follow accepted intent; the selected combination must be proved.
All-drop preserves useful observations and unique results; selection is not destruction.
Actual benefit is measured against deployed identity, baseline, environment and window, not inferred from acceptance.
Real-use evidence can refute applicability while preserving historical results.
Positive, negative and inconclusive evidence can inform later changes.
Feedback proposes new investigation rather than changing authority or history.
Learning re-enters interpretation and explicit acceptance.
Exact recoverable results enable Agent handoff and safe exit under fresh authority.
Only accounted-for results and coordinated quiescence admit controlled retirement.
